clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Azar Stronghammer calls young dwarven paladins away from their field duties and sends them to Ironforge. He directs each initiate to Tiza Battleforge in the Hall of Mysteries for guidance, beginning deeper trials in service to the Holy Light.

Dwarven initiates begin by guarding Dun Morogh's snowbound villages and roads. When Azar Stronghammer sees that a defender is ready for deeper spiritual instruction, he sends the promising candidate from field duties to Ironforge. There, the initiate can seek guidance from the city's holy elders.

The summons leads you to the Mystic Ward, then up to the Hall of Mysteries. Tiza Battleforge waits there, upstairs among sacred relics and solemn study. A respected dwarven champion of the Light, she tests whether you are ready for self-sacrifice, mercy, and the moral duties of your calling.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should make your way up to Ironforge to speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries. If you've never been there, it's in the Mystic Ward. Good luck to ya, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well met, friend. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
